subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 5: Culture – The world of the corner shop
outcomes: Read about corner shops in different countries.
Match names for corner shops to countries and cities.
Write and present a short advert for a shop.

tf.s: In Australia, a corner shop is called a milk bar.
tf.why: Australians call it a milk bar.

tf.s: In New Zealand, a corner shop is called a bodega.
tf.why: In New Zealand it is called a dairy. A bodega is in New York.

tf.s: In New York, a corner shop is called a bodega.
In Canada, a corner shop is called a corner store.
In Detroit, a corner shop is called a milk bar.
tf.why: In Detroit it is called a party shop.

tf.s: People go to a corner shop to get something quickly and easily.
tf.why: Corner shops are near and fast.

tf.s: Corner shops in the UK also sell stamps and stationery.
tf.why: They sell stamps, cleaning products and stationery too.

tf.s: In a TV advert, you should sound bored.
tf.why: In an advert you should sound excited.

tf.s: "Come to our friendly shop …" is a phrase for an advert.
tf.why: It invites people to the shop.
Corner shops sell things like sweets, drinks and newspapers.

boxes.why: In Australia it is a milk bar.

boxes.q: What is a corner shop called in New Zealand?
boxes.why: In New Zealand it is a dairy.

boxes.q: Where is a corner shop called a party shop?

boxes.why: Corner shops are quick and easy.

boxes.why: Dream Gifts sells the best gifts and cards.

boxes.q: Which phrase can end an advert?
o: You will be happy that you came here!
boxes.why: This phrase ends the advert happily.

mcq.why: A milk bar is in Australia.

mcq.q: What do UK corner shops also sell?
mcq.why: They sell stamps, cleaning products and stationery.

mcq.q: What is the speaking tip for the advert?
mcq.why: An excited voice makes the advert interesting.

o: We also sold birthday cards yesterday.

mcq.q: You need a newspaper and a drink fast. Where can you go?
mcq.why: Corner shops sell these things and are quick.

mcq.q: Choose the best first line for an advert.

o: They can get things quickly and easily.
Corner shops are very far away.

mcq.q: How is a corner shop in Oman like a corner shop in the UK?
o: Both sell sweets, drinks and newspapers.
mcq.why: They sell many of the same things.

mcq.q: Which is the best order for an advert?
o: Come to our shop … You can buy … We also sell … You will be happy that you came here!
You will be happy … Come to our shop …
How much is it? It's five rials.
mcq.why: Invite, say what you sell, then end happily.
